unmappedReports: Module / cell temperature (channel 0, T1). The vendor assigns T1 to solar module temperature and T2 to ambient. MetricKind has only the generic `temperature` and the qualified `battery-temperature`; there is no `module-temperature` or `cell-temperature`, so the two channels collapse onto one wire name and the physically distinct quantity is lost., Wind speed. The Fronius Wind Sensor is read as pulses on a digital channel and the Datamanager converts it to km/h, mph or m/s. There is no `wind-speed` MetricKind and no `Unit` for km/h, mph or m/s. This is the single largest contract gap for this dialect - the Wind Sensor is a catalogued retail model with nowhere to land., Cumulative irradiation energy (Wh/m2, kWh/m2). Offered as a digital-channel unit and actually present in the vendor's own NowSensorData example (channel 4, unit KWh/m2). `pv-irradiance` is instantaneous W/m2; there is no energy-per-area MetricKind and no Wh/m2 or kWh/m2 `Unit`., Carbon intensity (kg CO2/kWh). In the vendor's digital/current channel unit list. No MetricKind, no Unit., Raw pulse frequency (Hz). Digital channels report Hz when no calibration factor has been applied - the vendor's MinMaxSensorData example shows channels 3 and 4 in Hz with SensorActive false. `Unit::Hertz` exists (used for ac-frequency) but there is no MetricKind for a pulse/counter rate., Sensor health / channel liveness. MinMaxSensorData carries a per-channel `SensorActive` boolean, and NowSensorData silently omits inactive channels and channels with damaged sensors. There is no MetricKind for sensor-present or sensor-faulted, so a driver cannot report the difference between 'zero irradiance' and 'the pyranometer fell off the rail'., Device-side min/max aggregates. MinMaxSensorData is a Day/Month/Year/Total extremum set computed inside the Datamanager. The contract has series and trend machinery but no MetricKind shape for a vendor-computed period extremum, so this collection has no home even though it is half of what the API offers., Reactive power (var) and rotational speed (rpm), both in the vendor's selectable unit list. `Unit::VoltAmpere` exists for apparent power but there is no var; no MetricKind for either., Resistance (ohm), mass (kg, t) and volume in cubic metres, also in the selectable unit list. `Unit::Litre` exists but m3 does not (the same factor-1000 mismatch already recorded for Victron GX tanks); ohm, kg and t are absent entirely., Generic installer-named channels. Channels 3, 4 and 5 carry an installer-assigned free-text channel name and an installer-chosen unit. The contract has no representation for a channel whose meaning is configuration rather than a fixed wire name - this is a shape problem, not a missing variant.
